goals.title: Choosing Your Host Before the Plunge
goals.summary: Before you ever plunge, the machine quietly hands you a choice most players miss: which symbiote host you play as for the ball. The two flippers do different jobs here — one changes your host, the other changes your skill shot — and the plunge locks both in.
instructions: Watch the display as your ball starts, before you plunge
Tap the left flipper button to change which host you play as
Tap the right flipper button to change which shot is lit for the skill shot
Plunge the ball to lock the host in for the ball
During the ball, shoot the left ramp while "change host" is lit to switch hosts mid-ball
goals.reward: Sets which host you play for the ball — Eddie Brock (Classic Venom), Flash Thompson (Agent Venom), Gwen Stacy (Gwenom), or Peter Parker (Black Suit Spider-Man) — changing your perks and hurry-up shots

goals.title: Level Up to Reach the Bosses
goals.summary: Your level is the spine of this game, not a decoration. Every task you finish feeds experience points, and three numbers decide how far you get: at level 10 a finished mini-mode path lights that host's symbiote battle at the centre ramp, at level 20 a beaten symbiote opens the fight with Grendel, and at level 30 a beaten Grendel opens Knull. Level also sets how hard you punch, so the same battle fought twenty levels higher is a far shorter fight. Sign in to Insider Connected and your level rides along to your next game — right up until you beat Knull, which drops you back to level 1 and starts the climb over.
instructions: Left ramp and scoop — Mayhem Multiball opens with quick jackpots alternating between these two shots, and every one of them pays experience. Keep the alternation clean and the level counter climbs fast.

Left containment vessel — put your third Mayhem lock on the left side to double experience for that multiball. The third lock on the right side gives +1X playfield instead, so pick the one you actually need.
Left ramp — change hosts here to fill a second grid column and close a square on the 2X Experience bonus, which doubles experience for as long as all four of its lights stay on.

Centre ramp — at level 10 with a host's mini-mode path complete, the centre ramp lights that host's symbiote battle. While it is lit you cannot start a multiball, so plan to take the fight rather than stall.
Centre ramp — beat a symbiote and reach level 20 to face Grendel, then beat Grendel and reach level 30 to face Knull. Winning that last fight resets your experience and puts you back at level 1.
goals.reward: Level 10 lights symbiote battles, level 20 plus a beaten symbiote opens Grendel, level 30 plus a beaten Grendel opens Knull — and every level raises the damage you deal

goals.title: Unlock and Spend a Team-Up
goals.summary: Team-ups are allies you bring into a fight, and you pick one from a selection screen as a multiball or battle mode starts rather than earning one mid-mode. There are three, and each has its own key. The cheapest key is your opening host: start the game as Flash Thompson and Sleeper is already unlocked, start as Peter Parker and Miles Morales is. Sleeper is a survival tool, Miles is a scoring tool, so which one you want depends on whether you are trying to stay alive or run the combo count up. Spending an ally uses it up — you have to earn it again before you can pick it a second time, while one you never spend waits for your next game if you are signed in.
instructions: Shooter lane — your first host of the game decides the free ally: open as Flash Thompson and Sleeper is unlocked, open as Peter Parker and Miles Morales is.
Infected targets — defeating Infected also unlocks Sleeper, so you can arm it without spending your opening host pick on Flash.
U-turn loop — completing a four-way combo unlocks Miles Morales the hard way; beating all four symbiotes, either in their battles or on a Mayhem super jackpot, unlocks Hybrid.
Scoop — when a multiball or battle mode starts, the selection screen appears. Highlight the ally you want and press the action button to lock it in.

Action button — spend Sleeper when the ball is in trouble: it adds a ball during multiball, or buys more time during a battle. With Miles instead, every combo you make counts as two, so shot multipliers build twice as quickly.
goals.reward: Sleeper adds a ball in multiball or time in a battle; Miles Morales makes every combo count twice; Hybrid arms a super bomb on the action button and pushes your playfield multiplier up

goals.title: Close a Square on the Grid
goals.summary: The lights just above the flippers are a progress grid, and each of the four hosts owns one column of three. Finishing a host's three mini-modes fills that host's column — but the rewards sit between the columns, not at the end of any one of them. Close a square of four adjoining lights and you hold the bonus printed inside it for as long as all four stay lit. That is why the strongest line is to finish one host's column, change hosts at the left ramp to a column beside it, and finish that one too: two full columns overlap into squares that a single column can never close on its own.
instructions: Shoot the solid yellow, blue or white arrow, then hit the matching arrow while it blinks and times out. That pair completes one mini-mode and fills one circle in your host's column.
Left ramp — completing all three of your host's mini-modes lights the host change here.
Left ramp — take the change and pick a host whose column sits next to the one you just filled, then run that host's three mini-modes as well. That is what closes a square.
Scoop — a mystery award can fill in a grid box outright, so a well-timed mystery is worth saving for a square you are one light short of.

Centre ramp — protect what you built. Losing a symbiote battle switches off the grid lights that led to it, and a square that loses a light loses its bonus. Hold the flamethrower square and a lit flamethrower shot pays off three shots at once.
goals.reward: A standing bonus for each closed square — longer timers, +1X playfield, 2X web combos, the flamethrower, longer ball saves, or 2X experience

drills.title: Hideout Plunge (Premium/LE)
drills.text: Hard-plunge into the upper hideout hole at the orbit's apex. It is the biggest plunge award on the machine, but a miss returns fast, so make sure the flippers are set before the ball comes back down.

drills.title: Bell Tower Ladder
drills.text: Loop the center ramp until the Bell Tower lights, then take the target for the multiplier step, and keep climbing. Each rung costs one more center ramp than the last, so the center ramp is the shot this whole game is really built on.

drills.title: Push Carnage Back
drills.text: Bash the captive ball hard enough to drive it all the way back into Ravencroft, not just move it. Half-hits do not advance the ladder, and the same full push is what relights the super later, so treat power as part of the aim.

drills.title: Edge Targets From a Cradle
drills.text: Take the far-left and far-right Infected standups one at a time from a settled cradle, never on a scramble. Both sit directly above an outlane, and a loose swing at either is the drain that ends good balls on this machine.

drills.title: Workhorse Loop
drills.text: Run the right ramp, the scoop, the left ramp, then back to the scoop. It never touches the center ramp, so you can grind it as long as you like without accidentally starting a battle you were not ready for.

drills.title: Web Arrow Chain
drills.text: Make any shot to light a fresh set of combo arrows, then keep taking lit continuation arrows before they time out. Count your longest chain — the shot multiplier it builds also multiplies the damage you deal in a battle, so the chain is never wasted.
drills.reps: note your longest chain over 3 balls

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: Venom leans on the lockdown bar button harder than most Sterns. It is your Spider-Sense, your ball-lock override, your team-up selector, and once Sleeper or Hybrid is unlocked it becomes the emergency button as well. Tap and hold do different jobs, so know which one you want before the ball is in trouble.

uses.when: Any mode running and you are stuck
uses.what: Hold for Spider-Sense: one random shot flashes white briefly, worth a hurry-up from 25M plus progress in that mode.
Hold to cancel the auto-start and keep locking, up to six balls and a better set of perks.
With the flippers, picks which team-up you take into the mode.
Adds a ball during multiball, or buys extra time during a timed battle.
One press collects every lit shot and adds +2x to playfield scoring for a short window.
Once per ball, a press scores every shot on the game and overrides the Hybrid bomb.

howItPlays.objective: You are a symbiote host fighting through the Marvel rogues' gallery. Pick your host, level up by clearing mini-modes and symbiote battles, drive the Bell Tower playfield multiplier, and push through Knull to the final wizard, Klyntar.
loop: Pick a host at the plunge, then complete the colored two-shot mini-modes to fill the Grid, raise your level, and light symbiote locks.
Lock balls in the left or right containment vessel for Mayhem Multiball, holding the action button after the second lock to keep locking toward a six-ball start.
Push the Carnage captive ball back into Ravencroft for Carnage Multiball, and loop the center ramp to arm the Bell Tower playfield multiplier up to 7X.
Beat the symbiote battles -- Riot, Phage, Scream, Rampage, and Blood Lust -- as your level and shot multiplier keep climbing.
Clear the eight objectives and defeat Knull to light Klyntar, the final wizard.

lights.name: Mini-Mode Arrows & Grid
lights.lit: A solid colored arrow marks the start of a mini-mode; hit it, then hit the blinking arrow it points you to, to complete the pair and fill one square of the Grid.
lights.flashing: The blinking arrow is the second half of the mini-mode you are running -- collect it before it moves on.
lights.then: Filling Grid columns raises your level and lights a symbiote lock. Level ten opens the first battles, and every closed square hands you a standing perk like a longer timer or an extra playfield multiplier.

lights.name: Containment Vessel Locks
lights.lit: A green arrow at a containment vessel is a lit lock; feed it to trap a ball, with left locks bringing the Agony and Lasher perks and right locks bringing Riot and Phage.

control.effect: after your second lock the button glows blue -- hold it to cancel the automatic Mayhem start and keep locking, all the way up to a six-ball multiball with a stronger set of perks

lights.then: Two locks start Mayhem Multiball, but banking more balls first makes it far bigger; if six looks too risky, at least take the right vessel's third lock for a permanent playfield multiplier bump.

lights.name: Carnage Captive Ball
lights.lit: Bashing the Carnage captive ball drives him back into Ravencroft, and sinking him fully lights the center ramp red to start Carnage Multiball.
lights.flashing: Once the multiball is running the other shots blink blue to build the Super, which lights over at the scoop.
lights.then: Start it at the center ramp, push Carnage all the way back again to light the Super Jackpot, and collect it at the Daily Bugle scoop. Every push after his multiball also climbs the Blood Lust ladder toward its own battle.

lights.name: Bell Tower Playfield X
lights.lit: Looping the Police Station center ramp -- twice the first time, then three, then four -- lights the Bell Tower target for a playfield multiplier.
lights.then: Hit the lit Bell Tower for +1X, climbing toward 7X, while hitting it unlit only adds time to the multiplier clock. Ratchet the multiplier up first, then fire your Host Hurry-Up and multiballs while it is live -- that overlap is where the billion-point games come from.

lights.name: Symbiote Battle Shots
lights.lit: Inside a symbiote battle the shots light in moving color sets -- a red set sweeping one way for the big hits, a blue set sweeping back for smaller ones -- and a shot lit both colors at once lands a Special Attack.
lights.then: Time your shots to the sliding colors rather than camping a lane, and hit the Bell Tower to buy more phase time. Winning Riot and Phage feeds your level, and clearing the lesser symbiotes qualifies the Knull battle.

lights.name: Infected Standups
lights.lit: The red Infected standups light to be knocked down, and clearing them triggers Doppelganger attacks and steps your bonus multiplier up.
lights.then: Defeat a full count of Infected to qualify Scream at the scoop, and beat three Doppelgangers to arm Rampage at the center ramp. Both battles pay heavily once your shot multiplier is stacked.

lights.name: Host Signature Combos
lights.lit: Each host has a four-shot signature combo, and running it lights a Host Hurry-Up over at the scoop.
lights.flashing: When the billboard blinks, the Host Hurry-Up is ready to start at the scoop.
lights.then: Start the hurry-up at the scoop and re-shoot the combo shots to cascade the value, lighting the Bell Tower multiplier first so the whole cascade is multiplied. Chaining web combos beforehand can push a single collect into the billions.

scoring.text: Pick your host at the plunge -- Eddie Brock starts with two locks already lit -- and take the safe top-lane skill shot, or gamble the Secret Hideout saucer for far more. Then clear the colored mini-modes to fill the Grid and light your first Mayhem locks.

Lock balls for Mayhem, holding the action button past the second lock to build toward six balls, and loop the center ramp to bank the Bell Tower multiplier. Overlap Carnage onto the Mayhem multiball's opening ball save and cash a Host Hurry-Up while the multiplier is live.

Play Mayhem and Carnage and beat a Doppelganger to open Toxin Team-Up, the mini-wizard. Then clear all eight objectives and defeat Knull to light Klyntar -- a final wizard of sixteen hurry-up shots that pour their values into one another as the playfield goes dark.
